# Pomo Build

Pomo Build is a Port Moody, British Columbia renovation and handyman contractor.

- Website: https://pomobuild.ca
- Phone: +1-604-500-2003
- Email: info@pomobuild.ca
- Address: 1924 Clarke St, Port Moody, BC V3H 1X9, Canada
- Hours: Monday–Saturday, 8:00am–6:00pm

## Services
- Bathroom and kitchen remodeling
- Major home renovations
- Basement finishing
- Decks and exterior work
- Commercial and tenant improvements
- Handyman services

## Service area
Based in Port Moody. Serves Metro Vancouver, including Port Moody, Coquitlam, Port Coquitlam, Anmore, Belcarra, Burnaby, Vancouver, North Vancouver, West Vancouver, Surrey, Richmond, New Westminster, Maple Ridge, Pitt Meadows, Langley, Delta, White Rock, Tsawwassen, Lions Bay, and UBC / UEL.

Bathroom renovation inquiries are common from Port Moody, Coquitlam, Port Coquitlam, Anmore, and Belcarra. Request a quote at https://pomobuild.ca/contact#quote-form or https://pomobuild.ca/services/kitchen-bath.
